en.quote: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
en.riddle: Why are ye now turned back?
en.speaker: Ahab

he.quote: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה־זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּֽם
he.speaker: אחאב

en.5: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

he.5: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים אֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מַה־זֶּה שַׁבְתֶּֽם׃

en.quote: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
en.speaker: King's messenger

he.quote: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים אַחֵר וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים כֹּֽה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מְהֵרָה רֵֽדָה
he.speaker: שליח הַמֶּלֶךְ

en.11: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

he.11: וַיָּשָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵלָיו שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁים אַחֵר וַחֲמִשָּׁיו וַיַּעַן וַיְדַבֵּר אֵלָיו אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים כֹּֽה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ מְהֵרָה רֵֽדָה׃
